              <div class="admin-field">
                <label for="admin-new-pass">Sandi Baru (min. 6 karakter)</label>
                <input id="admin-new-pass" type="password" name="newPasscode" placeholder="Sandi baru (min. 6 karakter)" required autocomplete="new-password">
              </div>
              <div class="admin-field admin-passcode-submit-wrap">
                <button type="submit" class="admin-btn admin-btn--secondary">Simpan Sandi Baru</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  };

  const render = () => {
    if (!session) {
      renderLoginScreen();
      return;
    }

    const state = getCmsState();
    const {crumb, title} = getTabTitle(activeTab);

    let bodyHtml = '';
    if (activeTab === 'overview') bodyHtml = renderOverviewTab(state);
    else if (activeTab === 'catalog') bodyHtml = renderCatalogTab(state);
    else if (activeTab === 'events') bodyHtml = renderEventsTab(state);
    else if (activeTab === 'board') bodyHtml = renderBoardTab(state);
    else bodyHtml = renderVisiMisiTab(state);

    dialog.innerHTML = `
      <div class="admin-workspace">
        <aside class="admin-sidebar">
          <div class="admin-sidebar-brand">
            <div class="admin-sidebar-brand-left">
              <img src="/assets/aistudio/logo_uda_uni_2027_a45f5678.png" width="32" height="32" alt="Logo">
              <div>
                <strong>Menu Admin</strong>
                <span class="admin-brand-sub-desktop">Mode Lokal (Non-Firebase)</span>
                <span class="admin-brand-sub-mobile">${escapeHtml(session.operatorName)} · Lokal</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="admin-mobile-head-actions">
              <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost" data-admin-logout>Keluar</button>
              <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--secondary" data-admin-close aria-label="Tutup Panel Admin">Tutup</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <nav class="admin-nav" aria-label="Menu utama Admin">
            <button type="button" class="admin-nav-btn ${activeTab === 'overview' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-switch-tab="overview">
              <span>Ringkasan &amp; Log</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="admin-nav-btn ${activeTab === 'catalog' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-switch-tab="catalog">
              <span>Katalog Uda &amp; Uni</span>
              <span class="admin-nav-count is-tabular">${state.catalogYears.length}</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="admin-nav-btn ${activeTab === 'events' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-switch-tab="events">
              <span>Berita &amp; Program</span>
              <span class="admin-nav-count is-tabular">${state.events.length}</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="admin-nav-btn ${activeTab === 'board' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-switch-tab="board">
              <span>Kepengurusan 2027</span>
              <span class="admin-nav-count is-tabular">${state.boardMembers.length}</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="admin-nav-btn ${activeTab === 'visimisi' ? 'is-active' : ''}" data-switch-tab="visimisi">
              <span>Visi, Misi &amp; Backup</span>
            </button>
          </nav>

          <div class="admin-sidebar-foot">
            <div class="admin-operator-badge">
              <strong>${escapeHtml(session.operatorName)}</strong>
              <span>Penyimpanan Browser Lokal</span>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost admin-btn--full" data-admin-logout>Kunci &amp; Keluar</button>
          </div>
        </aside>

        <div class="admin-main">
          <header class="admin-topbar">
            <div class="admin-breadcrumb">
              <span>Portal Uda &amp; Uni</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">/</span>
              <strong>${escapeHtml(crumb)}</strong>
            </div>
            <div class="admin-topbar-actions">
              <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--secondary" data-action="export-json">Backup JSON</button>
              <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost admin-tablet-only-btn" data-admin-logout>Keluar</button>
              <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost" data-admin-close>Tutup Panel</button>
            </div>
          </header>

          ${
            pendingConfirm
              ? `
              <div class="admin-confirm-bar" role="alert">
                <span>${escapeHtml(pendingConfirm.label)}</span>
                <div class="admin-confirm-actions">
                  <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--ghost" data-confirm-cancel>Batal</button>
                  <button type="button" class="admin-btn admin-btn--danger" data-confirm-proceed>Ya, Lanjutkan</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            `
              : ''
          }

          ${
            toastMessage
              ? `<div class="admin-toast admin-toast--${toastType}" data-admin-toast>${escapeHtml(toastMessage)}</div>`
              : ''
          }

          <div class="admin-viewport">
            <div class="admin-view-title">
              <h2>${escapeHtml(title)}</h2>
            </div>
            ${bodyHtml}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    bindRenderedEvents();

    // Keep active navigation pill visible when scrolling horizontal mobile tab bar
    if (window.innerWidth <= 980) {
      const activeNav = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.admin-nav-btn.is-active');
      activeNav?.scrollIntoView({inline: 'nearest', block: 'nearest'});
    }
  };

  const scrollToMobileSection = (selector: string) => {
    if (window.innerWidth > 980) return;
    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const target = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
      target?.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});
    });
  };

  const bindRenderedEvents = () => {
    dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-admin-close]').forEach((el) => {
      el.addEventListener('click', () => dialog.close());
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-admin-logout]').forEach((el) => {
      el.addEventListener('click', () => {
        clearAdminSession();
        session = null;
        render();
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll-to-list]').forEach((el) => {
      el.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const listEl = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.admin-split-list');
        listEl?.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-switch-tab]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const nextTab = btn.dataset.switchTab as AdminTab;
        if (!nextTab) return;
        activeTab = nextTab;
        pendingConfirm = null;
        uploadStatNote = '';
        render();
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-action="export-json"]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const dateTag = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        downloadTextFile(`backup-uda-uni-sumbar-${dateTag}.json`, exportCmsBackupJson(), 'application/json');
        showToast('Backup JSON berhasil diunduh.', 'success');
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelector('[data-action="export-csv"]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const dateTag = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      downloadTextFile(`katalog-uda-uni-${dateTag}.csv`, exportCatalogCsv(), 'text/csv;charset=utf-8');
      showToast('Katalog Uda & Uni diekspor ke format CSV.', 'success');
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-action="download-repomix"]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
          const resp = await fetch('/repomix-output.txt', {cache: 'no-cache'});
          if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('File Repomix belum tersedia.');
          const text = await resp.text();
          downloadTextFile('repomix-uda-uni-sumbar.txt', text, 'text/plain;charset=utf-8');
          showToast('File Repomix (.txt) berhasil diunduh.', 'success');
        } catch {
          showToast('Gagal mengunduh file Repomix (.txt).', 'error');
        }
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelector('[data-confirm-cancel]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      pendingConfirm = null;
      render();
    });
    dialog.querySelector('[data-confirm-proceed]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const fn = pendingConfirm?.onConfirm;
      pendingConfirm = null;
      fn?.();
    });

    // Catalog bindings
    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-cat-year]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectedYear = btn.dataset.catYear || selectedYear;
        selectedSlotIndex = 0;
        uploadStatNote = '';
        render();
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-cat-role]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectedRole = (btn.dataset.catRole as RoleFilter) || 'uda';
        selectedSlotIndex = 0;
        uploadStatNote = '';
        render();
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-cat-slot]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectedSlotIndex = Number(btn.dataset.catSlot || 0);
        uploadStatNote = '';
        render();
        scrollToMobileSection('.admin-split-editor');
      });
    });

    const catSearch = dialog.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-cat-search]');
    catSearch?.addEventListener('input', () => {
      catalogQuery = catSearch.value;
      const caret = catSearch.selectionStart ?? catalogQuery.length;
      render();
      const restored = dialog.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-cat-search]');
      if (restored) {
        restored.focus();
        restored.setSelectionRange(caret, caret);
      }
    });

    dialog.querySelector('[data-cat-toggle-new-year]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      newYearMode = !newYearMode;
      render();
    });
    dialog.querySelector('[data-cat-cancel-new-year]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      newYearMode = false;
      render();
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('[data-cat-add-year-form]')?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement);
      const yearStr = String(fd.get('year') || '').trim();
      if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(yearStr)) {
        showToast('Masukkan tahun 4 digit yang valid.', 'error');
        return;
      }
      const next = cloneState();
      if (next.catalogYears.some((y) => y.year === yearStr)) {
        showToast(`Angkatan ${yearStr} sudah ada.`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      next.catalogYears.unshift(createTemplateYearLineup(yearStr, 'published'));
      next.catalogYears.sort((a, b) => Number(b.year) - Number(a.year));
      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Katalog',
        action: 'Tambah Tahun Angkatan',
        summary: `Menambahkan angkatan ${yearStr} lengkap dengan 19 slot Uda & 19 slot Uni.`,
      });
      newYearMode = false;
      selectedYear = yearStr;
      selectedSlotIndex = 0;
      showToast(`Angkatan ${yearStr} berhasil dibuat dan langsung tayang di katalog.`, 'success');
    });

    dialog.querySelector('[data-cat-toggle-year-status]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const next = cloneState();
      const target = next.catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === selectedYear);
      if (!target) return;
      target.status = target.status === 'published' ? 'draft' : 'published';
      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Katalog',
        action: 'Ubah Status Angkatan',
        summary: `Angkatan ${target.year} diubah ke status ${target.status === 'published' ? 'Tayang' : 'Draft'}.`,
      });
      showToast(`Status angkatan ${target.year} diperbarui.`, 'success');
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-cat-upload-photo]')?.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      const input = e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement;
      const file = input.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      try {
        const res = await saveCompressedAdminImage(file, 'portrait');
        const next = cloneState();
        const yearObj = next.catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === selectedYear);
        const list = selectedRole === 'uda' ? yearObj?.uda : yearObj?.uni;
        const person = list?.[selectedSlotIndex];
        if (!person) return;
        person.photo = {thumb: res.refUrl, full: res.refUrl};
        saveCmsState(next, {
          operator: session?.operatorName,
          module: 'Katalog',
          action: 'Unggah Foto Duta',
          summary: `${person.shortName} (${selectedYear}) — dikompres ${formatBytesCompact(res.originalBytes)} → ${formatBytesCompact(res.compressedBytes)}.`,
        });
        uploadStatNote = `Terkompres: ${formatBytesCompact(res.originalBytes)} → ${formatBytesCompact(res.compressedBytes)} (${res.width}×${res.height}px)`;
        showToast('Foto potret dikompresi, disimpan ke browser & diterapkan ke panggung utama.', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Gagal memproses foto.', 'error');
      }
    });

    dialog.querySelector('[data-cat-reset-photo]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const next = cloneState();
      const yearObj = next.catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === selectedYear);
      const list = selectedRole === 'uda' ? yearObj?.uda : yearObj?.uni;
      const person = list?.[selectedSlotIndex];
      if (!person) return;
      delete person.photo;
      uploadStatNote = '';
      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Katalog',
        action: 'Reset Foto Slot',
        summary: `Mengembalikan foto ${person.shortName} (${selectedYear}) ke siluet bawaan.`,
      });
      showToast('Foto profil dikembalikan ke siluet bawaan.', 'info');
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('[data-cat-save-form]')?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement);
      const next = cloneState();
      const yearObj = next.catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === selectedYear);
      const list = selectedRole === 'uda' ? yearObj?.uda : yearObj?.uni;
      const person = list?.[selectedSlotIndex];
      if (!person) return;

      person.fullName = String(fd.get('fullName') || person.fullName).trim();
      person.shortName = String(fd.get('shortName') || person.shortName).trim();
      person.rankLabel = String(fd.get('rankLabel') || person.rankLabel).trim();
      person.region = String(fd.get('region') || person.region).trim();
      const finalistNumber = String(fd.get('finalistNumber') || '').trim();
      if (finalistNumber) person.finalistNumber = finalistNumber;
      else delete person.finalistNumber;
      const age = String(fd.get('age') || '').trim();
      if (age) person.age = age;
      else delete person.age;
      person.education = String(fd.get('education') || '').trim();
      person.profession = String(fd.get('profession') || '').trim();
      person.advocacy = String(fd.get('advocacy') || '').trim();
      const achievementsList = String(fd.get('achievementsText') || '')
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .map((line) => line.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
      const singleAchievement = String(fd.get('achievement') || '').trim();
      if (achievementsList.length > 0) {
        person.achievements = achievementsList;
        person.achievement = singleAchievement || achievementsList.join(' · ');
      } else {
        delete person.achievements;
        person.achievement = singleAchievement;
      }
      person.bio = String(fd.get('bio') || '').trim();

      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Katalog',
        action: 'Perbarui Profil Duta',
        summary: `Menyimpan perubahan ${person.shortName} (${person.region}, ${selectedYear}).`,
      });
      showToast(`Profil ${person.shortName} tersimpan dan langsung aktif di katalog.`, 'success');
    });

    // Events bindings
    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-ev-select]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectedEventId = btn.dataset.evSelect || selectedEventId;
        uploadStatNote = '';
        render();
        scrollToMobileSection('.admin-split-editor');
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelector('[data-ev-add]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const next = cloneState();
      const created = createEmptyEvent();
      next.events.push(created);
      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Event',
        action: 'Tambah Event Baru',
        summary: `Menambahkan draft event baru "${created.title}".`,
      });
      selectedEventId = created.id;
      showToast('Event baru ditambahkan (status Draft). Silakan lengkapi & publikasikan.', 'info');
      scrollToMobileSection('.admin-split-editor');
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-ev-move]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.dataset.evId;
        const delta = Number(btn.dataset.evMove || 0);
        const next = cloneState();
        const idx = next.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === id);
        const targetIdx = idx + delta;
        if (idx < 0 || targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= next.events.length) return;
        const [item] = next.events.splice(idx, 1);
        next.events.splice(targetIdx, 0, item);
        saveCmsState(next, {
          operator: session?.operatorName,
          module: 'Event',
          action: 'Urutkan Event',
          summary: `Memindahkan urutan "${item.title}" ke posisi #${targetIdx + 1}.`,
        });
        showToast('Urutan Berita dan Program Kegiatan diperbarui.', 'success');
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-ev-delete]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const id = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).dataset.evDelete;
        const target = getCmsState().events.find((ev) => ev.id === id);
        if (!id || !target) return;
        pendingConfirm = {
          key: `del-ev-${id}`,
          label: `Hapus permanen event "${target.title}"?`,
          onConfirm: () => {
            const next = cloneState();
            next.events = next.events.filter((ev) => ev.id !== id);
            saveCmsState(next, {
              operator: session?.operatorName,
              module: 'Event',
              action: 'Hapus Event',
              summary: `Menghapus event "${target.title}".`,
            });
            selectedEventId = next.events[0]?.id ?? '';
            showToast('Event berhasil dihapus.', 'info');
          },
        };
        render();
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-ev-upload-photo]')?.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      const file = (e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement).files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      try {
        const res = await saveCompressedAdminImage(file, 'landscape');
        const next = cloneState();
        const ev = next.events.find((item) => item.id === selectedEventId);
        if (!ev) return;
        ev.photo = res.refUrl;
        saveCmsState(next, {
          operator: session?.operatorName,
          module: 'Event',
          action: 'Unggah Foto Event',
          summary: `Foto "${ev.title}" dikompres ${formatBytesCompact(res.originalBytes)} → ${formatBytesCompact(res.compressedBytes)}.`,
        });
        uploadStatNote = `Terkompres: ${formatBytesCompact(res.originalBytes)} → ${formatBytesCompact(res.compressedBytes)} (${res.width}×${res.height}px)`;
        showToast('Foto event diperbarui pada Section 2 & pop-up detail.', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Gagal memproses foto event.', 'error');
      }
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('[data-ev-save-form]')?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement);
      const next = cloneState();
      const ev = next.events.find((item) => item.id === selectedEventId);
      if (!ev) return;

      ev.status = fd.get('status') === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'published';
      ev.category = String(fd.get('category') || ev.category).trim();
      ev.title = String(fd.get('title') || ev.title).trim();
      ev.modalKicker = String(fd.get('modalKicker') || ev.modalKicker).trim();
      ev.focusLine = String(fd.get('focusLine') || '').trim();
      ev.cardSummary = String(fd.get('cardSummary') || '').trim();
      ev.detailSummary = String(fd.get('detailSummary') || '').trim();
      ev.photoAlt = ev.title;
      ev.metrics = [0, 1, 2].map((idx) => ({
        value: String(fd.get(`metricVal_${idx}`) || '').trim(),
        label: String(fd.get(`metricLabel_${idx}`) || '').trim(),
      }));
      ev.details = [0, 1, 2]
        .map((idx) => ({
          label: String(fd.get(`detailLabel_${idx}`) || '').trim(),
          text: String(fd.get(`detailText_${idx}`) || '').trim(),
        }))
        .filter((d) => d.label || d.text);

      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Event',
        action: 'Simpan Event',
        summary: `Memperbarui "${ev.title}" (${ev.status === 'published' ? 'Tayang' : 'Draft'}).`,
      });
      showToast(`Program "${ev.title}" disimpan dan langsung diperbarui di halaman depan.`, 'success');
    });

    // Board bindings
    dialog.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('[data-bd-summary-form]')?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement);
      const next = cloneState();
      const items: CmsBoardSummaryItem[] = next.boardSummary.map((orig, idx) => ({
        id: orig.id,
        label: String(fd.get(`sumLabel_${idx}`) || orig.label).trim(),
        value: String(fd.get(`sumVal_${idx}`) || orig.value).trim(),
        unit: String(fd.get(`sumUnit_${idx}`) || '').trim(),
      }));
      next.boardSummary = items;
      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Pengurus',
        action: 'Perbarui Ringkasan Angka',
        summary: `Memperbarui 3 angka ringkasan Section 3 (${items.map((i) => `${i.label}: ${i.value}`).join(', ')}).`,
      });
      showToast('Ringkasan angka Section Kepengurusan diperbarui.', 'success');
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-bd-select]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectedBoardId = btn.dataset.bdSelect || selectedBoardId;
        uploadStatNote = '';
        render();
        scrollToMobileSection('.admin-split-editor');
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelector('[data-bd-add]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const next = cloneState();
      const created = createEmptyBoardMember();
      next.boardMembers.push(created);
      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Pengurus',
        action: 'Tambah Pengurus Baru',
        summary: `Menambahkan draft profil pengurus "${created.cardName}".`,
      });
      selectedBoardId = created.id;
      showToast('Profil pengurus baru ditambahkan (Draft). Lengkapi data & publikasikan.', 'info');
      scrollToMobileSection('.admin-split-editor');
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-bd-move]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const id = btn.dataset.bdId;
        const delta = Number(btn.dataset.bdMove || 0);
        const next = cloneState();
        const idx = next.boardMembers.findIndex((m) => m.id === id);
        const targetIdx = idx + delta;
        if (idx < 0 || targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= next.boardMembers.length) return;
        const [item] = next.boardMembers.splice(idx, 1);
        next.boardMembers.splice(targetIdx, 0, item);
        saveCmsState(next, {
          operator: session?.operatorName,
          module: 'Pengurus',
          action: 'Urutkan Pengurus',
          summary: `Memindahkan urutan "${item.cardName}" ke posisi #${targetIdx + 1}.`,
        });
        showToast('Urutan kartu pengurus 2027 diperbarui.', 'success');
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-bd-delete]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const id = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).dataset.bdDelete;
        const target = getCmsState().boardMembers.find((m) => m.id === id);
        if (!id || !target) return;
        pendingConfirm = {
          key: `del-bd-${id}`,
          label: `Hapus permanen profil pengurus "${target.name}"?`,
          onConfirm: () => {
            const next = cloneState();
            next.boardMembers = next.boardMembers.filter((m) => m.id !== id);
            saveCmsState(next, {
              operator: session?.operatorName,
              module: 'Pengurus',
              action: 'Hapus Pengurus',
              summary: `Menghapus profil pengurus "${target.name}".`,
            });
            selectedBoardId = next.boardMembers[0]?.id ?? '';
            showToast('Profil pengurus dihapus.', 'info');
          },
        };
        render();
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-bd-upload-photo]')?.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      const file = (e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement).files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      try {
        const res = await saveCompressedAdminImage(file, 'portrait');
        const next = cloneState();
        const member = next.boardMembers.find((m) => m.id === selectedBoardId);
        if (!member) return;
        member.photo = res.refUrl;
        saveCmsState(next, {
          operator: session?.operatorName,
          module: 'Pengurus',
          action: 'Unggah Foto Pengurus',
          summary: `Foto "${member.cardName}" dikompres ${formatBytesCompact(res.originalBytes)} → ${formatBytesCompact(res.compressedBytes)}.`,
        });
        uploadStatNote = `Terkompres: ${formatBytesCompact(res.originalBytes)} → ${formatBytesCompact(res.compressedBytes)} (${res.width}×${res.height}px)`;
        showToast('Foto pengurus diperbarui di kartu 3D & pop-up detail.', 'success');
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Gagal memproses foto pengurus.', 'error');
      }
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('[data-bd-save-form]')?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement);
      const next = cloneState();
      const member = next.boardMembers.find((m) => m.id === selectedBoardId);
      if (!member) return;

      const divKey = String(fd.get('divisionKey') || 'budaya') as CmsBoardMember['divisionKey'];
      member.status = fd.get('status') === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'published';
      member.divisionKey = divKey;
      member.isCore = divKey === 'inti';
      member.name = String(fd.get('name') || member.name).trim();
      member.cardName = String(fd.get('cardName') || member.cardName).trim();
      member.cardRolePrefix = String(fd.get('cardRolePrefix') || member.cardRolePrefix).trim();
      member.cardRoleCopy = String(fd.get('cardRoleCopy') || '').trim();
      member.role = String(fd.get('role') || member.role).trim();
      member.division = String(fd.get('division') || member.division).trim();
      member.origin = String(fd.get('origin') || '').trim();
      member.cohortYear = String(fd.get('cohortYear') || '').trim();
      member.badge = String(fd.get('badge') || '').trim();
      member.summary = String(fd.get('summary') || '').trim();
      member.photoAlt = `${member.name} — ${member.role}`;
      member.tasks = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => String(fd.get(`task_${i}`) || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);

      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Pengurus',
        action: 'Simpan Pengurus',
        summary: `Memperbarui profil "${member.name}" (${member.status === 'published' ? 'Tayang' : 'Draft'}).`,
      });
      showToast(`Profil ${member.cardName} tersimpan dan kartu 3D langsung diperbarui.`, 'success');
    });

    // Visi Misi & Backup bindings
    dialog.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('[data-vm-save-form]')?.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement);
      const next = cloneState();
      const vm = next.visimisi;

      vm.eyebrow = String(fd.get('eyebrow') || vm.eyebrow).trim();
      vm.sealLabel = String(fd.get('sealLabel') || vm.sealLabel).trim();
      vm.chips = String(fd.get('chips') || '')
        .split(',')
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
      vm.visiQuoteLead = String(fd.get('visiQuoteLead') || vm.visiQuoteLead).trim();
      vm.visiQuoteMuted = String(fd.get('visiQuoteMuted') || '').trim();
      vm.visiDesc = String(fd.get('visiDesc') || '').trim();

      const readGroup = (prefix: string, orig: CmsMisiEntry[]): CmsMisiEntry[] =>
        orig.map((item, idx) => ({
          indexLabel: String(fd.get(`${prefix}_idx_${idx}`) || item.indexLabel).trim(),
          title: String(fd.get(`${prefix}_title_${idx}`) || item.title).trim(),
          description: String(fd.get(`${prefix}_desc_${idx}`) || item.description).trim(),
        }));

      vm.misiItems = readGroup('misi', vm.misiItems);
      vm.sebaranItems = readGroup('sebaran', vm.sebaranItems);
      vm.komitmenItems = readGroup('komitmen', vm.komitmenItems);

      saveCmsState(next, {
        operator: session?.operatorName,
        module: 'Visi & Misi',
        action: 'Simpan Visi & Misi',
        summary: 'Memperbarui kutipan Visi, 4 Misi Strategis, Sebaran 19 Kab/Kota, & Sapta Pesona.',
      });
      showToast('Data Visi & Misi berhasil disimpan dan diterapkan.', 'success');
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('[data-action-import-json]')?.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
      const file = (e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement).files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      try {
        const text = await file.text();
        const res = importCmsBackupJson(text, session?.operatorName);
        if (!res.ok) {
          showToast(res.error, 'error');
          return;
        }
        selectedYear = res.state.catalogYears[0]?.year ?? '2024';
        selectedEventId = res.state.events[0]?.id ?? '';
        selectedBoardId = res.state.boardMembers[0]?.id ?? '';
        showToast('Backup JSON berhasil diimpor dan diterapkan ke seluruh situs.', 'success');
      } catch {
        showToast('Gagal membaca file JSON.', 'error');
      }
    });

    dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-reset-mod]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const mod = btn.dataset.resetMod as 'catalog' | 'events' | 'board' | 'visimisi' | 'all';
        const labelMap: Record<typeof mod, string> = {
          catalog: 'Pulihkan Katalog Uda & Uni ke data bawaan? Foto upload pada katalog akan dilepas dari slot.',
          events: 'Pulihkan seluruh Berita dan Program Kegiatan ke data bawaan?',
          board: 'Pulihkan Struktur Kepengurusan 2027 ke data bawaan?',
          visimisi: 'Pulihkan Visi & Misi ke teks bawaan?',
          all: 'Pulihkan SELURUH data portal ke setelan bawaan awal?',
        };
        pendingConfirm = {
          key: `reset-${mod}`,
          label: labelMap[mod],
          onConfirm: () => {
            const updated = resetCmsModule(mod, session?.operatorName);
            selectedYear = updated.catalogYears[0]?.year ?? '2024';
            selectedEventId = updated.events[0]?.id ?? '';
            selectedBoardId = updated.boardMembers[0]?.id ?? '';
            showToast('Data berhasil dipulihkan ke bawaan.', 'info');
          },
        };
        render();
      });
    });

    dialog.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>('[data-passcode-form]')?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement);
      const currentPass = String(fd.get('currentPasscode') || '');
      const newPass = String(fd.get('newPasscode') || '');
      const res = await updateAdminPasscode(currentPass, newPass);
      if (!res.ok) {
        showToast(res.error || 'Gagal mengganti sandi.', 'error');
        return;
      }
      showToast('Kata sandi admin lokal berhasil diperbarui.', 'success');
    });
  };
}

================
File: src/cmsStore.ts
================
export type RoleFilter = 'uda' | 'uni';
export type PublishStatus = 'published' | 'draft';

export interface CohortPhoto {
  thumb: string;
  full: string;
}

export interface AmbassadorBio {
  role: RoleFilter;
  slotIndex: number;
  rankLabel: string;
  fullName: string;
  shortName: string;
  titleBadge: string;
  region: string;
  age?: string;
  finalistNumber?: string;
  education: string;
  profession: string;
  bio: string;
  advocacy: string;
  achievement: string;
  achievements?: string[];
  photo?: CohortPhoto;
}

export interface YearLineup {
  year: string;
  status: PublishStatus;
  uda: AmbassadorBio[];
  uni: AmbassadorBio[];
}

export interface CmsEventMetric {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface CmsEventDetail {
  label: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface CmsEventItem {
  id: string;
  status: PublishStatus;
  category: string;
  modalKicker: string;
  title: string;
  focusLine: string;
  cardSummary: string;
  detailSummary: string;
  photo: string;
  photoAlt: string;
  metrics: CmsEventMetric[];
  details: CmsEventDetail[];
}

export interface CmsBoardSummaryItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  unit: string;
}

export interface CmsBoardMember {
  id: string;
  status: PublishStatus;
  isCore: boolean;
  divisionKey: 'inti' | 'budaya' | 'promosi' | 'kemitraan';
  name: string;
  cardName: string;
  cardRolePrefix: string;
  cardRoleCopy: string;
  role: string;
  division: string;
  badge: string;
  cohortYear: string;
  origin: string;
  photo: string;
  photoAlt: string;
  summary: string;
  tasks: string[];
}

export interface CmsMisiEntry {
  indexLabel: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface CmsVisiMisiData {
  eyebrow: string;
  visiMutedTitle: string;
  chips: string[];
  visiQuoteLead: string;
  visiQuoteMuted: string;
  visiDesc: string;
  misiMutedTitle: string;
  misiItems: CmsMisiEntry[];
  sebaranItems: CmsMisiEntry[];
  komitmenItems: CmsMisiEntry[];
  sealLabel: string;
}

export interface CmsActivityEntry {
  id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  operator: string;
  module: 'Katalog' | 'Event' | 'Pengurus' | 'Visi & Misi' | 'Sistem';
  action: string;
  summary: string;
}

export interface CmsState {
  version: number;
  updatedAt: string;
  catalogYears: YearLineup[];
  events: CmsEventItem[];
  boardSummary: CmsBoardSummaryItem[];
  boardMembers: CmsBoardMember[];
  visimisi: CmsVisiMisiData;
  activityLog: CmsActivityEntry[];
}

export interface AdminSession {
  operatorName: string;
  roleLabel: string;
  loggedInAt: string;
}

export interface CompressedUploadResult {
  refUrl: string;
  objectUrl: string;
  originalBytes: number;
  compressedBytes: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  mimeType: string;
}

function getCohortPhoto(year: string, role: RoleFilter, region: string): CohortPhoto | undefined {
  if (year === '2024') {
    return PHOTOS_2024_BY_ROLE[role][region];
  }
  if (year === '2022') {
    return PHOTOS_2022_BY_ROLE[role][region];
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function getRegionalHonorific(role: RoleFilter, region: string): string {
  const normalized = region.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (normalized === 'kota bukittinggi') {
    return role === 'uda' ? 'Bujang' : 'Gadih';
  }
  if (normalized === 'kota pariaman' || normalized === 'kab. padang pariaman') {
    return role === 'uda' ? 'Cik Ajo' : 'Cik Uniang';
  }
  return role === 'uda' ? 'Uda' : 'Uni';
}

export function formatParticipantNameWithHonorific(
  rawName: string,
  role: RoleFilter,
  region: string,
): string {
  const trimmed = rawName.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return trimmed;
  const stripped = trimmed.replace(/^(?:uda|uni|bujang|gadih|cik\s+ajo|cik\s+uniang)\s+/i, '').trim();
  const prefix = getRegionalHonorific(role, region);
  return stripped ? `${prefix} ${stripped}` : prefix;
}

function buildOfficialCohortBio(
  year: string,
  role: RoleFilter,
  slotIndex: number,
  seed: Official2024Seed,
): AmbassadorBio {
  const leadAchievement = seed.achievements[0] ?? `${seed.rankLabel} ${year}`;
  const ageSegment = seed.age ? ` (${seed.age})` : '';
  const displayName = formatParticipantNameWithHonorific(seed.fullName, role, seed.region);
  return {
    role,
    slotIndex,
    rankLabel: seed.rankLabel,
    fullName: displayName,
    shortName: displayName,
    titleBadge: `Finalis No. ${seed.finalistNumber} · ${seed.rankLabel} ${year}`,
    region: seed.region,
    age: seed.age,
    finalistNumber: seed.finalistNumber,
    education: seed.education,
    profession: `Finalis Duta Wisata Sumbar ${year} · ${seed.education}`,
    bio: `${displayName}${ageSegment} adalah finalis nomor ${seed.finalistNumber} utusan resmi ${seed.region} dengan predikat ${seed.rankLabel} pada ajang Pemilihan Uda & Uni Duta Wisata Provinsi Sumatera Barat ${year}. Rekam jejak prestasinya antara lain ${leadAchievement}.`,
    advocacy: '',
    achievement: seed.achievements.join(' · '),
    achievements: [...seed.achievements],
    photo: getCohortPhoto(year, role, seed.region),
  };
}

function buildOfficial2024Lineup(): YearLineup {
  return {
    year: '2024',
    status: 'published',
    uda: OFFICIAL_2024_UDA.map((seed, idx) => buildOfficialCohortBio('2024', 'uda', idx, seed)),
    uni: OFFICIAL_2024_UNI.map((seed, idx) => buildOfficialCohortBio('2024', 'uni', idx, seed)),
  };
}

function buildOfficial2022Lineup(): YearLineup {
  return {
    year: '2022',
    status: 'published',
    uda: OFFICIAL_2022_UDA.map((seed, idx) => buildOfficialCohortBio('2022', 'uda', idx, seed)),
    uni: OFFICIAL_2022_UNI.map((seed, idx) => buildOfficialCohortBio('2022', 'uni', idx, seed)),
  };
}

function buildDefaultCatalogYears(): YearLineup[] {
  return [buildOfficial2024Lineup(), buildOfficial2022Lineup()];
}

const CMS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 7;

export function createDefaultCmsState(): CmsState {
  return {
    version: CMS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    catalogYears: buildDefaultCatalogYears(),
    events: buildDefaultEvents(),
    boardSummary: buildDefaultBoardSummary(),
    boardMembers: buildDefaultBoardMembers(),
    visimisi: buildDefaultVisiMisi(),
    activityLog: [
      {
        id: 'log-seed-init',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        operator: 'Sistem Bawaan',
        module: 'Sistem',
        action: 'Inisialisasi Data',
        summary: 'Data portal dimuat dalam mode penyimpanan lokal (termasuk profil resmi finalis 2024 dan 2022).',
      },
    ],
  };
}

const CMS_STORAGE_KEY = 'uda-uni:cms-state:v1';
const ADMIN_AUTH_KEY = 'uda-uni:cms-auth:v1';
const ADMIN_SESSION_KEY = 'uda-uni:admin-session:v1';
const DEFAULT_PASSCODE_SALT = 'uda-uni-sumbar-2027';
const DEFAULT_PASSCODE = 'sumbar2027';
const IDB_NAME = 'uda-uni-cms-db';
const IDB_STORE = 'media';

const resolvedMediaUrls = new Map<string, string>();
const listeners = new Set<(state: CmsState) => void>();

let cachedState: CmsState | null = null;
let idbPromise: Promise<IDBDatabase | null> | null = null;

function cloneJson<T>(data: T): T {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)) as T;
}

function mergeCatalogDefaults(savedYears: YearLineup[] | undefined, defaults: YearLineup[]): YearLineup[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(savedYears) || savedYears.length === 0) return defaults;
  return savedYears
    .filter((y) => y && typeof y.year === 'string' && Array.isArray(y.uda) && Array.isArray(y.uni))
    .map((y) => ({
      year: y.year,
      status: (y.status === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'published') as PublishStatus,
      uda: y.uda.map((p, idx) => ({
        ...p,
        role: 'uda' as const,
        slotIndex: typeof p.slotIndex === 'number' ? p.slotIndex : idx,
      })),
      uni: y.uni.map((p, idx) => ({
        ...p,
        role: 'uni' as const,
        slotIndex: typeof p.slotIndex === 'number' ? p.slotIndex : idx,
      })),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => Number(b.year) - Number(a.year));
}

export function loadCmsState(): CmsState {
  if (cachedState) return cachedState;
  const defaults = createDefaultCmsState();
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(CMS_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      cachedState = defaults;
      return cachedState;
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<CmsState>;
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
      cachedState = defaults;
      return cachedState;
    }

    let catalogYears = mergeCatalogDefaults(parsed.catalogYears, defaults.catalogYears);
    const savedVersion = typeof parsed.version === 'number' ? parsed.version : 1;
    let migrated = false;

    if (savedVersion < 2) {
      const official2024 = defaults.catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === '2024');
      if (official2024) {
        const without2024 = catalogYears.filter((y) => y.year !== '2024');
        catalogYears = [...without2024, official2024].sort((a, b) => Number(b.year) - Number(a.year));
        migrated = true;
      }
    }
    if (savedVersion < 3) {
      const year2024 = catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === '2024');
      if (year2024) {
        for (const p of [...year2024.uda, ...year2024.uni]) {
          if (!p.photo || p.photo.thumb.includes('silhouette-')) {
            const cohortPhoto = getCohortPhoto('2024', p.role, p.region);
            if (cohortPhoto) {
              p.photo = cohortPhoto;
              migrated = true;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (savedVersion < 4) {
      const official2022 = defaults.catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === '2022');
      if (official2022) {
        const without2022 = catalogYears.filter((y) => y.year !== '2022');
        catalogYears = [...without2022, official2022].sort((a, b) => Number(b.year) - Number(a.year));
        migrated = true;
      }
    }
    if (savedVersion < 5) {
      for (const yearLineup of catalogYears) {
        for (const p of [...yearLineup.uda, ...yearLineup.uni]) {
          const prevFull = p.fullName;
          const nextFull = formatParticipantNameWithHonorific(p.fullName, p.role, p.region);
          const nextShort = formatParticipantNameWithHonorific(p.shortName || p.fullName, p.role, p.region);
          if (nextFull !== p.fullName || nextShort !== p.shortName) {
            if (prevFull && p.bio?.startsWith(prevFull)) {
              p.bio = nextFull + p.bio.slice(prevFull.length);
            }
            p.fullName = nextFull;
            p.shortName = nextShort;
            migrated = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (savedVersion < 6) {
      const year2024 = catalogYears.find((y) => y.year === '2024');
      if (year2024) {
        for (const p of [...year2024.uda, ...year2024.uni]) {
          const cohortPhoto = getCohortPhoto('2024', p.role, p.region);
          if (cohortPhoto) {
            p.photo = cohortPhoto;
            migrated = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (savedVersion < 7) {
      const filtered = catalogYears.filter((y) => y.year !== '2025' && y.year !== '2026');
      if (filtered.length !== catalogYears.length) {
        catalogYears = filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : defaults.catalogYears;
        migrated = true;
      }
    }

    cachedState = {
      version: CMS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      updatedAt: typeof parsed.updatedAt === 'string' ? parsed.updatedAt : defaults.updatedAt,
      catalogYears,
      events:
        Array.isArray(parsed.events) && parsed.events.length > 0
          ? parsed.events
          : defaults.events,
      boardSummary:
        Array.isArray(parsed.boardSummary) && parsed.boardSummary.length > 0
          ? parsed.boardSummary
          : defaults.boardSummary,
      boardMembers:
        Array.isArray(parsed.boardMembers) && parsed.boardMembers.length > 0
          ? parsed.boardMembers
          : defaults.boardMembers,
      visimisi:
        parsed.visimisi && typeof parsed.visimisi === 'object'
          ? {...defaults.visimisi, ...parsed.visimisi}
          : defaults.visimisi,
      activityLog: Array.isArray(parsed.activityLog) ? parsed.activityLog.slice(0, 80) : defaults.activityLog,
    };

    if (migrated) {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(CMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cachedState));
      } catch {
        // ignore quota error during migration
      }
    }

    return cachedState;
  } catch {
    cachedState = defaults;
    return cachedState;
  }
}

export function getCmsState(): CmsState {
  return loadCmsState();
}

export function subscribeCmsChange(listener: (state: CmsState) => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

function notifyCmsChange(state: CmsState): void {
  listeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn(state);
    } catch {
      // ignore subscriber render error
    }
  });
}

export function saveCmsState(
  next: CmsState,
  logInfo?: {
    operator?: string;
    module: CmsActivityEntry['module'];
    action: string;
    summary: string;
  },
): CmsState {
  const updated: CmsState = cloneJson(next);
  updated.version = CMS_SCHEMA_VERSION;
  updated.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  if (logInfo) {
    const entry: CmsActivityEntry = {
      id: `log-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
      timestamp: updated.updatedAt,
      operator: logInfo.operator?.trim() || getAdminSession()?.operatorName || 'Admin Lokal',
      module: logInfo.module,
      action: logInfo.action,
      summary: logInfo.summary,
    };
    updated.activityLog = [entry, ...(updated.activityLog || [])].slice(0, 80);
  }

  cachedState = updated;
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(CMS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
  } catch {
    // quota fallback — still keep updated in-memory
  }
  notifyCmsChange(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function getPublishedCatalogYears(): YearLineup[] {
  const state = loadCmsState();
  const published = state.catalogYears.filter((y) => y.status !== 'draft');
  return published.length > 0 ? published : state.catalogYears;
}

export function getPublishedEvents(): CmsEventItem[] {
  const state = loadCmsState();
  const published = state.events.filter((e) => e.status !== 'draft');
  return published.length > 0 ? published : state.events;
}

export function getPublishedBoardMembers(): CmsBoardMember[] {
  const state = loadCmsState();
  const published = state.boardMembers.filter((m) => m.status !== 'draft');
  return published.length > 0 ? published : state.boardMembers;
}

export function createTemplateYearLineup(yearStr: string, status: PublishStatus = 'published'): YearLineup {
  const buildSlots = (role: RoleFilter): AmbassadorBio[] =>
    SUMBAR_REGIONS.map((region, idx) => {
      const prefix = role === 'uda' ? 'Uda' : 'Uni';
      const honorific = getRegionalHonorific(role, region);
      const rank = RANK_LABELS[idx] ?? 'Utusan';
      const rankLabel = idx === 0 ? `${prefix} Utama` : `${prefix} ${rank}`;
      const shortName = `${honorific} Utusan ${region.replace(/^(Kota|Kab\.)\s+/, '')}`;
      return {
        role,
        slotIndex: idx,
        rankLabel,
        fullName: shortName,
        shortName,
        titleBadge: `${rankLabel} Duta Wisata Sumbar ${yearStr}`,
        region,
        education: 'Sarjana — Perguruan Tinggi',
        profession: `${rankLabel} Sumatera Barat ${yearStr} · Duta Wisata ${region}`,
        bio: `Delegasi resmi ${region} pada Pemilihan Uda & Uni Duta Wisata Provinsi Sumatera Barat angkatan ${yearStr}.`,
        advocacy: `Promosi destinasi wisata unggulan dan pelestarian budaya di ${region}.`,
        achievement: `${rankLabel} Duta Wisata Sumatera Barat ${yearStr} · Utusan ${region}`,
      };
    });

  return {
    year: yearStr,
    status,
    uda: buildSlots('uda'),
    uni: buildSlots('uni'),
  };
}

export function resetCmsModule(
  module: 'catalog' | 'events' | 'board' | 'visimisi' | 'all',
  operatorName?: string,
): CmsState {
  const defaults = createDefaultCmsState();
  const current = cloneJson(loadCmsState());

  if (module === 'catalog') {
    current.catalogYears = defaults.catalogYears;
    return saveCmsState(current, {
      operator: operatorName,
      module: 'Katalog',
      action: 'Reset Modul',
      summary: 'Mengembalikan data Katalog Uda & Uni ke data bawaan awal.',
    });
  }
  if (module === 'events') {
    current.events = defaults.events;
    return saveCmsState(current, {
      operator: operatorName,
      module: 'Event',
      action: 'Reset Modul',
      summary: 'Mengembalikan data Berita dan Program Kegiatan ke data bawaan awal.',
    });
  }
  if (module === 'board') {
    current.boardSummary = defaults.boardSummary;
    current.boardMembers = defaults.boardMembers;
    return saveCmsState(current, {
      operator: operatorName,
      module: 'Pengurus',
      action: 'Reset Modul',
      summary: 'Mengembalikan struktur Kepengurusan 2027 & angka ringkasan ke data bawaan.',
    });
  }
  if (module === 'visimisi') {
    current.visimisi = defaults.visimisi;
    return saveCmsState(current, {
      operator: operatorName,
      module: 'Visi & Misi',
      action: 'Reset Modul',
      summary: 'Mengembalikan data Visi, Misi, Sebaran & Sapta Pesona ke data bawaan.',
    });
  }

  return saveCmsState(defaults, {
    operator: operatorName,
    module: 'Sistem',
    action: 'Reset Total',
    summary: 'Seluruh data portal dikembalikan ke kondisi bawaan awal.',
  });
}

export function exportCmsBackupJson(): string {
  const state = loadCmsState();
  return JSON.stringify(state, null, 2);
}

export function exportCatalogCsv(): string {
  const state = loadCmsState();
  const escapeCsv = (val: string) => `"${String(val ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  const headers = [
    'Tahun',
    'StatusTahun',
    'Kelompok',
    'Urutan',
    'NoFinalis',
    'Gelar',
    'NamaLengkap',
    'NamaSingkat',
    'UtusanDaerah',
    'Umur',
    'PendidikanPekerjaan',
    'Profesi',
    'FokusAdvokasi',
    'PrestasiMandat',
    'Biografi',
    'FotoThumb',
  ];
  const rows: string[] = [headers.join(',')];
  for (const yearLineup of state.catalogYears) {
    for (const person of [...yearLineup.uda, ...yearLineup.uni]) {
      const prestasiText =
        Array.isArray(person.achievements) && person.achievements.length > 0
          ? person.achievements.join(' | ')
          : person.achievement;
      rows.push(
        [
          yearLineup.year,
          yearLineup.status,
          person.role === 'uda' ? 'Uda' : 'Uni',
          String(person.slotIndex + 1),
          person.finalistNumber ?? '',
          person.rankLabel,
          person.fullName,
          person.shortName,
          person.region,
          person.age ?? '',
          person.education,
          person.profession,
          person.advocacy,
          prestasiText,
          person.bio,
          person.photo?.thumb ?? '',
        ]
          .map(escapeCsv)
          .join(','),
      );
    }
  }
  return rows.join('\r\n');
}

export function importCmsBackupJson(
  jsonText: string,
  operatorName?: string,
): {ok: true; state: CmsState} | {ok: false; error: string} {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonText) as Partial<CmsState>;
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
      return {ok: false, error: 'Format file JSON tidak valid.'};
    }
    const defaults = createDefaultCmsState();
    const merged: CmsState = {
      version: CMS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      catalogYears: mergeCatalogDefaults(parsed.catalogYears, defaults.catalogYears),
      events: Array.isArray(parsed.events) && parsed.events.length ? parsed.events : defaults.events,
      boardSummary:
        Array.isArray(parsed.boardSummary) && parsed.boardSummary.length
          ? parsed.boardSummary
          : defaults.boardSummary,
      boardMembers:
        Array.isArray(parsed.boardMembers) && parsed.boardMembers.length
          ? parsed.boardMembers
          : defaults.boardMembers,
      visimisi:
        parsed.visimisi && typeof parsed.visimisi === 'object'
          ? {...defaults.visimisi, ...parsed.visimisi}
          : defaults.visimisi,
      activityLog: Array.isArray(parsed.activityLog) ? parsed.activityLog : [],
    };
    const saved = saveCmsState(merged, {
      operator: operatorName,
      module: 'Sistem',
      action: 'Impor Backup JSON',
      summary: `Memuat cadangan JSON (${merged.catalogYears.length} tahun, ${merged.events.length} event, ${merged.boardMembers.length} pengurus).`,
    });
    return {ok: true, state: saved};
  } catch {
    return {ok: false, error: 'File JSON gagal dibaca atau strukturnya rusak.'};
  }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * IndexedDB Compressed Media Store (Firebase Storage replacement while local)
 * ============================================================================ */

function openMediaDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase | null> {
  if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') return Promise.resolve(null);
  if (idbPromise) return idbPromise;

  idbPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
    try {
      const req = indexedDB.open(IDB_NAME, 1);
      req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
        const db = req.result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(IDB_STORE)) {
          db.createObjectStore(IDB_STORE);
        }
      };
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
      req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    } catch {
      resolve(null);
    }
  });
  return idbPromise;
}

export async function hydrateCmsMediaUrls(): Promise<void> {
  const db = await openMediaDb();
  if (!db) return;

  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    try {
      const tx = db.transaction(IDB_STORE, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(IDB_STORE);
      const req = store.openCursor();
      req.onsuccess = () => {
        const cursor = req.result;
        if (cursor) {
          const key = String(cursor.key);
          const blob = cursor.value as Blob;
          if (blob instanceof Blob && blob.size > 0 && !resolvedMediaUrls.has(key)) {
            resolvedMediaUrls.set(key, URL.createObjectURL(blob));
          }
          cursor.continue();
        } else {
          resolve();
        }
      };
      req.onerror = () => resolve();
    } catch {
      resolve();
    }
  });
}

export function resolveCmsImageUrl(src: string | undefined): string {
  if (!src) return '';
  if (src.startsWith('cms-media://')) {
    return resolvedMediaUrls.get(src) ?? '/assets/placeholders/silhouette-uda.svg';
  }
  return src;
}

function canvasToBlob(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, mimeType: string, quality: number): Promise<Blob | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => resolve(blob), mimeType, quality);
  });
}

function loadBitmapOrImage(file: File): Promise<{
  width: number;
  height: number;
  draw: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, w: number, h: number) => void;
  cleanup: () => void;
}> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof createImageBitmap === 'function') {
      createImageBitmap(file)
        .then((bmp) => {
          resolve({
            width: bmp.width,
            height: bmp.height,
            draw: (ctx, w, h) => ctx.drawImage(bmp, 0, 0, w, h),
            cleanup: () => bmp.close(),
          });
        })
        .catch(() => fallbackImg());
    } else {
      fallbackImg();
    }

    function fallbackImg() {
      const obj = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        resolve({
          width: img.naturalWidth,
          height: img.naturalHeight,
          draw: (ctx, w, h) => ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h),
          cleanup: () => URL.revokeObjectURL(obj),
        });
      };
      img.onerror = () => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(obj);
        reject(new Error('Gambar tidak dapat dibaca.'));
      };
      img.src = obj;
    }
  });
}

export async function saveCompressedAdminImage(
  file: File,
  preset: 'portrait' | 'landscape',
): Promise<CompressedUploadResult> {
  if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
    throw new Error('Pilih file gambar (JPG, PNG, atau WebP).');
  }

  const maxW = preset === 'portrait' ? 900 : 1280;
  const maxH = preset === 'portrait' ? 1400 : 960;
  const decoded = await loadBitmapOrImage(file);

  try {
    const scale = Math.min(1, maxW / decoded.width, maxH / decoded.height);
    const outW = Math.max(1, Math.round(decoded.width * scale));
    const outH = Math.max(1, Math.round(decoded.height * scale));

    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = outW;
    canvas.height = outH;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) {
      throw new Error('Browser tidak mendukung kompresi kanvas.');
    }

    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
    decoded.draw(ctx, outW, outH);

    // Keep alpha channel intact with WebP; preserve lossless PNG transparency if PNG is already compact
    let mimeType = 'image/webp';
    let blob = await canvasToBlob(canvas, 'image/webp', 0.82);
    if (!blob || blob.size === 0) {
      mimeType = 'image/jpeg';
      ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-over';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, outW, outH);
      blob = await canvasToBlob(canvas, 'image/jpeg', 0.84);
    }

    if (!blob) {
      throw new Error('Gagal mengompresi foto.');
    }

    const mediaKey = `cms-media://img-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    const db = await openMediaDb();
    if (db) {
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const tx = db.transaction(IDB_STORE, 'readwrite');
        tx.objectStore(IDB_STORE).put(blob!, mediaKey);
        tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        tx.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Gagal menyimpan foto ke IndexedDB.'));
      });
    }

    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    resolvedMediaUrls.set(mediaKey, objectUrl);

    return {
      refUrl: mediaKey,
      objectUrl,
      originalBytes: file.size,
      compressedBytes: blob.size,
      width: outW,
      height: outH,
      mimeType,
    };
  } finally {
    decoded.cleanup();
  }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Local Admin Passcode Auth (Placeholder before Firebase Auth)
 * ============================================================================ */

async function hashPasscode(passcode: string): Promise<string> {
  const input = `${DEFAULT_PASSCODE_SALT}:${passcode}`;
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.subtle) {
    const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
    const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', encoded);
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest))
      .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
      .join('');
  }
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    h ^= input.charCodeAt(i);
    h += (h << 1) + (h << 4) + (h << 7) + (h << 8) + (h << 24);
  }
  return `fnv-${(h >>> 0).toString(16)}`;
}

export async function verifyAdminPasscode(passcode: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const trimmed = passcode.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return false;
  const candidateHash = await hashPasscode(trimmed);
  try {
    const storedHash = window.localStorage.getItem(ADMIN_AUTH_KEY);
    if (!storedHash) {
      const defaultHash = await hashPasscode(DEFAULT_PASSCODE);
      window.localStorage.setItem(ADMIN_AUTH_KEY, defaultHash);
      return candidateHash === defaultHash;
    }
    return candidateHash === storedHash;
  } catch {
    return trimmed === DEFAULT_PASSCODE;
  }
}

export async function updateAdminPasscode(
  currentPasscode: string,
  newPasscode: string,
): Promise<{ok: boolean; error?: string}> {
  const validCurrent = await verifyAdminPasscode(currentPasscode);
  if (!validCurrent) {
    return {ok: false, error: 'Sandi saat ini tidak sesuai.'};
  }
  if (newPasscode.trim().length < 6) {
    return {ok: false, error: 'Sandi baru minimal 6 karakter.'};
  }
  try {
    const nextHash = await hashPasscode(newPasscode.trim());
    window.localStorage.setItem(ADMIN_AUTH_KEY, nextHash);
    return {ok: true};
  } catch {
    return {ok: false, error: 'Gagal menyimpan sandi ke penyimpanan browser.'};
  }
}

export function isUsingDefaultPasscodeHint(): boolean {
  try {
    return !window.localStorage.getItem(ADMIN_AUTH_KEY);
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

export function getDefaultPasscodeValue(): string {
  return DEFAULT_PASSCODE;
}

export function getAdminSession(): AdminSession | null {
  try {
    const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(ADMIN_SESSION_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as AdminSession;
    return parsed && typeof parsed.operatorName === 'string' ? parsed : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function setAdminSession(operatorName: string, roleLabel = 'Admin Pengelola'): AdminSession {
  const session: AdminSession = {
    operatorName: operatorName.trim() || 'Admin Sekretariat',
    roleLabel,
    loggedInAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  try {
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(ADMIN_SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(session));
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
  return session;
}

export function clearAdminSession(): void {
  try {
    window.sessionStorage.removeItem(ADMIN_SESSION_KEY);
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}

export function formatBytesCompact(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0 B';
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
}

interface ClassicBodyState {
  el: HTMLElement;
  idx: number;
  x: number;
  g: number;
  v: number;
  from: number;
  goal: number;
  trip: boolean;
  w: number;

interface RingBodyState {

const clamp = (v: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v));

const MEDIA_CACHE_NAME = 'uda-uni-media-cache-v1';
const FOOT_CACHE_STORAGE_KEY = 'uda-uni:foot-offsets:v1';

const decodedImageUrls = new Set<string>();
const decodedImageRefs = new Map<string, HTMLImageElement>();
const blobUrlCache = new Map<string, string>();
const preloadImagePromises = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
const footOffsetCache = new Map<string, string>();
const footProbePromises = new Map<string, Promise<string | null>>();

let mediaCachePromise: Promise<Cache | null> | null = null;
let footSaveTimer = 0;

function hydrateFootOffsetCache(): void {
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(FOOT_CACHE_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, string>;
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return;
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(parsed)) {
      if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0) {
        footOffsetCache.set(k, v);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage access errors in restricted contexts
  }
}

function scheduleFootOffsetPersist(): void {
  if (footSaveTimer) return;
  footSaveTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
    footSaveTimer = 0;
    try {
      const serialized: Record<string, string> = {};
      footOffsetCache.forEach((v, k) => {
        serialized[k] = v;
      });
      window.localStorage.setItem(FOOT_CACHE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(serialized));
    } catch {
      // Ignore quota or privacy storage errors
    }
  }, 400);
}

hydrateFootOffsetCache();

function getMediaCache(): Promise<Cache | null> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('caches' in window)) {
    return Promise.resolve(null);
  }
  if (!mediaCachePromise) {
    mediaCachePromise = window.caches.open(MEDIA_CACHE_NAME).catch(() => null);
  }
  return mediaCachePromise;
}

function resolveCachedMediaUrl(url: string): string {
  if (url.startsWith('cms-media://')) {
    return resolveCmsImageUrl(url);
  }
  return blobUrlCache.get(url) ?? url;
}

async function ensureBlobUrlFromCache(url: string, highPriority = false): Promise<string> {
  if (url.startsWith('cms-media://')) {
    return resolveCmsImageUrl(url);
  }
  const existingBlob = blobUrlCache.get(url);
  if (existingBlob) return existingBlob;

  try {
    const cache = await getMediaCache();
    if (cache) {
      const cachedRes = await cache.match(url);
      if (cachedRes) {
        const blob = await cachedRes.blob();
        if (blob.size > 0) {
          const objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          blobUrlCache.set(url, objUrl);
          return objUrl;
        }
      }

      const fetchInit: RequestInit & {priority?: string} = {
        cache: 'force-cache',
      };
      if (highPriority) fetchInit.priority = 'high';

      const netRes = await fetch(url, fetchInit);
      if (netRes && netRes.ok) {
        await cache.put(url, netRes.clone());
        const blob = await netRes.blob();
        if (blob.size > 0) {
          const objUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          blobUrlCache.set(url, objUrl);
          return objUrl;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fallback cleanly to standard browser image loading
  }
  return url;
}

function registerMediaCacheWorker(): void {
  if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return;
  const start = () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', {scope: '/'}).catch(() => {
      // Ignore registration error if preview environment restricts SW
    });
  };
  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    start();
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('load', start, {once: true});
  }
}

function getPreferredPhotoUrl(photo: CohortPhoto): string {
  if (!photo.full || photo.full === photo.thumb) return photo.thumb;
  const dpr = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.devicePixelRatio || 1 : 1;
  const width = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth : 1280;
  const renderWidth = width >= 1800 ? 540 : width >= 750 ? 420 : 320;
  return renderWidth * dpr > 680 ? photo.full : photo.thumb;
}

function preloadImageUrl(url: string, highPriority = false): Promise<void> {
  if (!url) return Promise.resolve();
  if (decodedImageRefs.has(url)) {
    decodedImageUrls.add(url);
    return Promise.resolve();
  }
  const existing = preloadImagePromises.get(url);
  if (existing) return existing;

  const task = ensureBlobUrlFromCache(url, highPriority).then(
    (resolvedUrl) =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const img = new Image();
        img.decoding = 'async';
        if ('fetchPriority' in img) {
          (img as HTMLImageElement & {fetchPriority?: string}).fetchPriority = highPriority ? 'high' : 'low';
        }
        const done = () => {
          decodedImageUrls.add(url);
          decodedImageRefs.set(url, img);
          resolve();
        };
        const fail = () => resolve();

        img.src = resolvedUrl;
        if (typeof img.decode === 'function') {
          img
            .decode()
            .then(done)
            .catch(() => {
              if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) done();
              else {
                img.addEventListener('load', done, {once: true});
                img.addEventListener('error', fail, {once: true});
              }
            });
        } else if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
          done();
        } else {
          img.addEventListener('load', done, {once: true});
          img.addEventListener('error', fail, {once: true});
        }
      }),
  );

  preloadImagePromises.set(url, task);
  return task;
}

function measureFootOffset(probeUrl: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const cached = footOffsetCache.get(probeUrl);
  if (cached !== undefined) return Promise.resolve(cached);

  const pending = footProbePromises.get(probeUrl);
  if (pending) return pending;

  const task = new Promise<string | null>((resolve) => {
    const probe = new Image();
    probe.decoding = 'async';
    if (!probeUrl.startsWith('/') && !probeUrl.startsWith('blob:') && !probeUrl.startsWith('cms-media://')) {
      probe.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    }
    probe.onload = () => {
      try {
        if (!probe.naturalWidth || !probe.naturalHeight) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        const w = 48;
        const h = Math.max(1, Math.round((w * probe.naturalHeight) / probe.naturalWidth));
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(probe, 0, 0, w, h);
        const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
        let lastRow = h - 1;
        let found = false;
        for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
          for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            if (data[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3] > 40) {
              lastRow = y;
              found = true;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (found) break;
        }
        if (!found) {
          resolve(null);
          return;
        }
        const footStr = clamp((h - 1 - lastRow) / h, 0, 0.4).toFixed(4);
        footOffsetCache.set(probeUrl, footStr);
        scheduleFootOffsetPersist();
        resolve(footStr);
      } catch {
        resolve(null);
      }
    };
    probe.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    probe.src = resolveCachedMediaUrl(probeUrl);
  });

  footProbePromises.set(probeUrl, task);
  return task;
}

function decodeModelImage(img: HTMLImageElement, targetKey?: string): void {
  const show = () => {
    if (targetKey) decodedImageUrls.add(targetKey);
    img.classList.add('is-decoded');
  };
  if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
    show();
    return;
  }
  if (typeof img.decode === 'function') {
    img
      .decode()
      .then(show)
      .catch(() => {
        if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) {
          show();
        } else {
          img.addEventListener('load', show, {once: true});
        }
      });
  } else {
    img.addEventListener('load', show, {once: true});
  }
}

class RunwaySection extends HTMLElement {
  private LOOK_COUNT: number = SUMBAR_REGIONS.length; // Dinamis sesuai jumlah utusan per tahun (mis. 16 utk 2024/2022)
  private BODY_COUNT: number = this.LOOK_COUNT * Math.ceil(8 / this.LOOK_COUNT);
  private readonly K = 95;
  private readonly C = 2 * Math.sqrt(95);

  private stage!: HTMLElement;
  private actorsEl!: HTMLElement;
  private heroesEl!: HTMLElement;
  private panelEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private liveEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private piecesEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private panelTitleEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private yearBadgeEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private autoBtn!: HTMLButtonElement | null;
  private cursorEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private lbEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private lbStageEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private lbKickerEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private lbNameEl!: HTMLElement | null;
  private lbCloseBtn!: HTMLButtonElement | null;

  private heroes: HTMLElement[] = [];
  private ticks: HTMLButtonElement[] = [];
  private panels: HTMLElement[] = [];
  private roleButtons: HTMLButtonElement[] = [];
  private yearButtons: HTMLButtonElement[] = [];
  private ringBodies: RingBodyState[] = [];
  private classicBodies: ClassicBodyState[] = [];
  private panelCache = new Map<string, {mhead: HTMLElement; ul: HTMLElement}[]>();

  private index = 0;
  private activeYear = getCatalogLineups()[0]?.year ?? DEFAULT_CATALOG_YEAR;
  private roleFilter: RoleFilter = 'uda';
  private activePanelRole: 'uda' | 'uni' = 'uda';
  private panelOpen = false;
  private target = 0;
  private cur = 0;
  private vel = 0;
  private still = false;
  private mode: 'ring' | 'classic' = 'ring';
  private isMobile = false;

  private W = 800;
  private H = 600;
  private fs = 1.08;
  private unit = 240;
  private latchedVh = 0;
  private latchedW = 0;

  private reducedMotion = false;
  private mqlMotion!: MediaQueryList;
  private visible = true;
  private playing = false;
  private engaged = false;
  private panelHover = false;
  private zoomed = false;
  private dragging = false;

  private rafId = 0;
  private measureRaf = 0;
  private lastTs = 0;
  private lastFrameH = -1;
  private lastModelH = -1;
  private autoTimer = 0;
  private resizeTimer = 0;
  private wheelLock = 0;
  private wheelAcc = 0;
  private lbClearTimer = 0;
  private suppressClickUntil = 0;
  private preloadTimer = 0;
  private preloadIdleId = 0;
  private preloadGen = 0;
  private tickMarqueeTimer = 0;

  private dragPointerId: number | null = null;
  private dragStartX = 0;
  private dragStartY = 0;
  private dragStartTarget = 0;
  private dragActive = false;
  private dragAbandoned = false;
  private dragSamples: {x: number; time: number}[] = [];

  private cursorTargetX = 0;
  private cursorTargetY = 0;
  private cursorX = 0;
  private cursorY = 0;
  private cursorRaf = 0;
  private cursorHoverCapable = false;

  private visObserver: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
  private revealObserver: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
  private stageResizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
  private cleanups: (() => void)[] = [];

  connectedCallback(): void {
    this.stage = this.querySelector('[data-rw-stage]')!;
    this.actorsEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-actors]')!;
    this.heroesEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-heroes]')!;
    this.panelEl = this.querySelector('.rw__panel');
    this.liveEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-live]');
    this.piecesEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-pieces]');
    this.panelTitleEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-panel-title]');
    this.yearBadgeEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-year-badge]');
    this.autoBtn = this.querySelector('[data-rw-auto]');
    this.cursorEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-cursor]');
    this.lbEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-lb]');
    this.lbStageEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-lb-stage]');
    this.lbKickerEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-lb-kicker]');
    this.lbNameEl = this.querySelector('[data-rw-lb-name]');
    this.lbCloseBtn = this.querySelector('[data-rw-zoom-close]');

    this.renderYearButtons();
    this.syncSlotCount();
    this.ensureSlotMarkup();

    this.heroes = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-rw-hero]'));
    this.ticks = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-rw-tick]'));
    this.panels = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-rw-panel]'));
    this.roleButtons = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-rw-role]'));
    this.yearButtons = Array.from(this.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[data-rw-year]'));

    this.mqlMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    this.reducedMotion = this.mqlMotion.matches;
    const onMotionChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
      this.reducedMotion = e.matches;
      if (this.reducedMotion) {
        this.play(false);
        this.classList.add('is-revealed');
      }
    };
    this.mqlMotion.addEventListener('change', onMotionChange);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.mqlMotion.removeEventListener('change', onMotionChange));

    this.classList.add('rw--js');

    this.renderAllPanels();
    this.syncRoleLabels();
    this.setupBodies();
    this.syncStageGroupMedia();
    this.setupImagesAndFeet();
    this.setupCursor();
    this.setupObservers();
    this.setupListeners();
    this.scheduleOppositeRolePreload();

    const startOffset = this.reducedMotion ? 0 : 1.15;
    this.index = 0;
    this.target = 0;
    this.cur = -startOffset;
    this.vel = 0;
    for (let a = 0; a < this.BODY_COUNT; a++) {
      const cb = this.classicBodies[a];
      cb.goal = a;
      cb.x = a + startOffset;
      cb.g = a + startOffset;
      cb.v = 0;
      cb.from = a + startOffset;
      cb.trip = false;
    }

    this.measure();
    this.setIndex(0, true);

    if (this.reducedMotion) {
      this.classList.add('is-revealed');
      this.cur = 0;
      this.setStill(true);
      this.renderAll();
    } else {
      this.kick();
      if (this.dataset.autoplay === 'true') {
        this.play(true);
      }
    }
  }

  disconnectedCallback(): void {
    if (this.rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(this.rafId);
    if (this.cursorRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(this.cursorRaf);
    if (this.measureRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(this.measureRaf);
    window.clearTimeout(this.autoTimer);
    window.clearTimeout(this.resizeTimer);
    window.clearTimeout(this.wheelLock);
    window.clearTimeout(this.lbClearTimer);
    window.clearTimeout(this.preloadTimer);
    window.clearTimeout(this.tickMarqueeTimer);
    if (this.preloadIdleId && typeof window.cancelIdleCallback === 'function') {
      window.cancelIdleCallback(this.preloadIdleId);
    }
    this.visObserver?.disconnect();
    this.revealObserver?.disconnect();
    this.stageResizeObserver?.disconnect();
    document.body.classList.remove('is-profile-focus');
    for (const fn of this.cleanups) fn();
    this.cleanups = [];
  }

  private renderYearButtons(): void {
    const container = this.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.rw__year-pills');
    if (!container) return;

    const existingThumb = container.querySelector('.pill-3d-thumb');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    if (existingThumb) {
      container.appendChild(existingThumb);
    } else {
      const thumb = document.createElement('span');
      thumb.className = 'pill-3d-thumb';
      thumb.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      container.appendChild(thumb);
    }

    getCatalogLineups().forEach((lineup) => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      const isActive = lineup.year === this.activeYear;
      btn.className = isActive ? 'rw__year-btn is-active' : 'rw__year-btn';
      btn.dataset.rwYear = lineup.year;
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isActive ? 'true' : 'false');
      btn.textContent = lineup.year;
      container.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  private ensureSlotMarkup(): void {
    const lineup = this.getActiveYearLineup();
    const list = this.roleFilter === 'uda' ? lineup.uda : lineup.uni;
    const basePhotos = this.roleFilter === 'uda' ? UDA_PHOTOS : UNI_PHOTOS;

    if (this.actorsEl) {
      this.actorsEl.innerHTML = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < this.LOOK_COUNT; i++) {
        const person = list[i];
        const photo = person?.photo ?? basePhotos[i % basePhotos.length];
        const altText = person ? `${person.shortName} (${person.region}) - ${lineup.year}` : `Peserta ${i + 1}`;
        const model = document.createElement('div');
        model.className = 'rw__model';
        model.setAttribute('data-rw-model', '');
        model.dataset.index = String(i);
        model.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        const resolvedThumb = resolveCachedMediaUrl(photo.thumb);
        const resolvedFull = photo.full ? resolveCachedMediaUrl(photo.full) : '';
        const srcsetAttr =
          resolvedFull && resolvedFull !== resolvedThumb
            ? ` srcset="${resolvedThumb} 640w, ${resolvedFull} 1080w"`
            : '';
        model.innerHTML = `
